messages:
Evan Ruiz: Thanks for the all-hands. Quick clarifying Q: for the customer wins vs losses you mentioned, can leadership list the top customer asks (one line each) and flag which are blockers vs nice-to-have?
Priya Shah: From sales notes — Wins: 1) predictable reliability/latency, 2) straightforward pricing for burst vs steady usage, 3) strong onboarding + docs. Losses: 1) missing compliance attestations (SOC2/data residency), 2) higher TCO for sustained heavy workloads, 3) inability to pin model versions. Blocker = compliance & TCO, model pinning often a tie-breaker.
Nora Kim: Product mapping: reliability -> autoscaling SLA + p95 improvements; pricing -> commit SKUs + usage caps; data controls -> per-tenant retention + KMS/HSM hooks. Must-have blockers: SOC2 & KMS support. Nice-to-have: advanced QoE telemetry.
Tom Berger: Eng perspective: quick wins we can do in weeks: improve autoscaler cooldown logic, KV cache warmup, and route-level priority. Medium (month): model-pin API + rollout hooks. Longer (quarter): quantized serving optimizations to cut TCO.
Heather V: CS datapoint: customers repeatedly request a "security bakeoff" packet to hand to their infosec — install checklist, sample audit answers, and a small recorded demo of Private deploy. That often unblocks procurement reviews.
Leah O'Neill: Onboarding: two customers told us they won solely because our onboarding playbook reduced their time-to-value. We should productize the playbook for Private installs.
Evan Ruiz: Can we capture owners + single-line acceptance criteria + ETA for each top item? e.g. SOC2 = owner + external audit signed; Model-pin = owner + beta with 2 customers.
Priya Shah: Proposed owners: SOC2 -> Heather + Rajiv Menon; Pricing experiments -> Priya; Model pin -> Nora Kim + Tom Berger; Security bakeoff packet -> Leah + Heather.
Nora Kim: I'll add one-liners to the roadmap doc today. Tentative ETAs: model-pin beta 30 days; security packet 10 business days; pricing SKUs experiment results 2 weeks; autoscale mitigations 2-3 weeks.
Tom Berger: FYI perf snapshot from demo cluster: p50 ~28ms, p95 ~180ms, p99 ~420ms on long-context workloads. I'll open a short RFC with mitigations + ops checklist. Example run command for the Private runbook: ```bash
./deploy_private_runbook.sh --validate --customer testcorp
```
Heather V: We'll also collect two customer validations for the onboarding playbook this week and report back.
ops-bot: Recording + notes uploaded: https://redwood.internal/records/allhands-2026-03-22-v2 ; Roadmap page: https://redwood.internal/roadmap/q2
Evan Ruiz: Thanks everyone. Let's reconvene in 2 weeks with owners' one-liners and any quant. I'll synthesize for PMs and execs. :raised_hands:
